executiveSummary: Asbestos was reported by the laboratory in four material zones. M01 Pipe insulation (B01 mechanical room, sample S01), M02 Floor tile and adhesive (G01 corridor, sample S02) and M03 Textured ceiling (G02 office, samples S03 and S07) are in category A and need priority professional review before any affected work. M05 Cement panel (E01 east elevation, sample S05) is in category B and is flagged for professional management review. For M02 the adhesive layer was detected and the floor tile layer was not detected. The planned ground corridor floor and office ceiling replacement affects M02 and M03.

M04 Wall plaster (G03 meeting room, sample S04) is category D: asbestos was not detected in the sampled material only. M06 Insulation fragment (B02 service room, sample S06) has an inconclusive result, and M07 Uninspected riser material (B03 locked riser, no samples) was inaccessible and not sampled. Both are category C and stay unresolved. The assessment covers accessible areas only, hidden materials were not inspected, and all text is a draft for professional review.
